name: Granite Lighting
description: Lighting specialist. Mid-range shop: fair market prices. We carry desk lamps, floor lamps.
skill_description: We sell desk lamps, floor lamps, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
